name: Irvington
title: Hudson River Paddling Conditions Near Irvington, NY
blurb: Scenic Hudson Park at the southern end of the Tappan Zee, where the river begins to widen. Piermont Marsh sits across the water.

tide.label: NOAA 8518919 Tarrytown
tide.note: Tide from NOAA station 8518919 at Tarrytown, about two and a half miles upriver.
tide.cardNote: Unless you plan on landing on a beach or poking into a shallow creek, tide is likely not very important to you.
